Jurisdictional Reinforcement in New Institutionalism: Evidence from Organizational Sustainability
abstract: A key dimension of institutionalization is the emergence of professional groups that become increasingly isomorphic across organizations. Yet recent institutional perspectives emphasize multiple, divergent pathways of institutionalization. This paper introduces a theory of jurisdictional reinforcement as both an alternative to and a complement to professionalization. Under jurisdictional reinforcement, institutionalization occurs within organizational jurisdictions where practices are already embedded, rather than through separate professional units. We test jurisdictional reinforcement alongside professionalization using original survey data from 149 firms, measuring both where sustainability work is already embedded across organizational units and where firms prioritize sustainability hiring across jurisdictions of work. We document isomorphic institutionalization and professionalization of sustainability, but largely confined to reporting and strategy functions. Most critically for jurisdictional reinforcement, when sustainability tasks already exist in particular organizational units such as operations, finance, and data, firms respond by deepening hiring in the corresponding functional jurisdictions of work, rather than implementing activities through sustainability units. Finally, when we examine jurisdictional reinforcement and professionalization together within the same domain, we find that they operate in tandem, reconciling existing accounts of isomorphic professionalization with new institutionalist accounts of organizational heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 制度化的一个关键维度，是专业群体的出现，且这些群体在各组织之间日益趋同（同构）。然而，近期的制度视角强调制度化存在多种相互分化的路径。本文提出“管辖权强化”理论，将其作为专业化的替代与补充。在管辖权强化机制下，制度化发生于已嵌入相关实践的组织管辖范围之内，而非通过独立的专业单位实现。我们利用来自149家企业的原始调查数据，检验管辖权强化与专业化的作用，同时测量可持续发展工作已嵌入组织各单位的情况，以及企业在各工作管辖领域中优先招聘可持续发展人才的情况。我们记录了可持续发展的同构制度化与专业化，但这主要局限于报告与战略职能。对于管辖权强化而言，最关键的发现是：当可持续发展任务已存在于运营、财务和数据等特定组织单位中时，企业会在相应的职能管辖领域加大招聘力度，而非通过可持续发展部门来执行这些活动。最后，当我们在同一领域中同时考察管辖权强化与专业化时，发现二者协同运作，从而调和了既有关于同构专业化的解释与新制度主义关于组织异质性的解释。
